summary: Workflow YAML is sound (pinned actions, minimal permissions, shell: pwsh). PowerShell scripts follow conventions (Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference, clear parameters). BUT: critical delivery gaps. Workflow references test files that don't exist (lines ~22–23: Tests/*.Tests.ps1). Harness references missing fixtures (fixtures/matrix-build, all-passing, ci-run) and .actrc without validation, will fail immediately. No act-result.txt generated. Task requires passing tests, fixtures, actionlint validation, act runs—none demonstrated. Code repetition: XML/JSON parsing error patterns (~60–120 lines) could refactor to helper. Harness lacks error handling around git/act commands.
